B right = t1_right == 1 and not t1_cap_hit; O right = score_v3 == 1 and not cap hit (cap_hit true, or missing and finish_reason == 'length'); null grade or missing problem on either side excluded. E row right = v3 right and not a cap hit; an E row with null text or gold counts as present in E but not right. Rule A: windows of 8,000 characters (text[p:p+8000]) at p = 0 or after '\n', ratio = zlib default-level compressed bytes / utf-8 bytes < 0.10. R3 is applied to normalised lines (N removes whitespace, '$', '*', '#', '\left', '\right'; \dfrac/\tfrac -> \frac), so the 'starts with Answer:' test is on normalised lines; a null gold is taken as ''. Denominator = all gap problems including unassigned ones. alt_measured: E rows graded by the v3 grade alone (cap hits not forced wrong), which changes kB only for E rows that hit the cap yet have a right v3 grade. Interval: bootstrap over gap problems. refuted_by is null, so refuted_by_met is always false.

Same ambiguities: R3 on normalised lines, null gold -> '', E rows with null text present but not right. alt_measured: kB counted from v3 grades alone (cap-hit E rows not forced wrong), which can only move problems from deliberation to reliability. refuted_by is null, so refuted_by_met is always false.
